description: Comprehensive lookup for major Indian festivals (Deepavali/Diwali, Pongal/Sankranti, Holi, Dussehra/Vijayadashami, Eid, Christmas, Independence Day, Republic Day), major global holidays, and user Google Calendar synchronization with explicit consent.

permission_flow.consent_prompt: To check your personal appointments, meetings, and saved birthdays, I can link with your Google Calendar or local schedule. Would you like to grant permission?

festivals_reference.name: Diwali / Deepavali
festivals_reference.significance: Festival of Lights celebrating the victory of light over darkness, knowledge over ignorance, and good over evil (Goddess Lakshmi puja, lighting diyas and fireworks).

festivals_reference.name: Holi
festivals_reference.significance: Festival of Colors celebrating the arrival of spring, love, and the triumph of Prahlada over Holika.

festivals_reference.name: Makar Sankranti / Pongal
festivals_reference.significance: Harvest festival dedicated to the Sun God (Surya) marking the transition into Makara rashi (Capricorn). Celebrated with kites, sweet pongal, and sesame jaggery.

festivals_reference.name: Dussehra / Vijayadashami
festivals_reference.significance: Celebrates Lord Rama's victory over Ravana and Goddess Durga's triumph over Mahishasura.

festivals_reference.name: Ganesh Chaturthi / Vinayaka Chavithi
festivals_reference.significance: Celebrates the birth of Lord Ganesha, the remover of obstacles and god of new beginnings.

festivals_reference.name: Ugadi / Gudi Padwa
festivals_reference.significance: New Year's Day for Deccan people, celebrated with Ugadi Pachadi symbolizing the six tastes of life.

festivals_reference.name: Independence Day (India)
festivals_reference.significance: Commemorates the nation's independence from British rule on 15 August 1947.

festivals_reference.name: Republic Day (India)
festivals_reference.significance: Honours the date on which the Constitution of India came into effect on 26 January 1950.

festivals_reference.name: Christmas
festivals_reference.significance: Celebrates the birth of Jesus Christ.

festivals_reference.name: New Year's Day
festivals_reference.significance: Welcoming the new Gregorian calendar year.

festivals_reference.name: Eid ul-Fitr
festivals_reference.significance: Marks the end of the sacred month of Ramadan with prayers, charity, and feast.

user_calendar_queries.phrase: Can you check my calendar for upcoming appointments?
user_calendar_queries.response: To check your personal meetings, events, or birthdays, I need your permission to access your Google Calendar. Would you like me to connect to your Calendar?

user_calendar_queries.phrase: What appointments do I have today?
user_calendar_queries.response: After permission is granted, I scan your schedule and announce your upcoming meetings and birthdays.
